note: Identical to greylist-receipt-cleared except that the body carries bare U+200B / U+FEFF padding of the kind a templating system or an HTML editor emits, with no injection payload anywhere in it. This was the engine's largest single source of over-rejection: triage raised 'hidden_unicode' on any zero-width character at all, which is a level-1 reject, so a catalogued receipt from a greylisted sender was thrown out for whitespace. Zero-width characters are evidence of concealment only when they are concealing something; on their own they are a formatting artefact. Was a strict xfail; now an ordinary guard, and its opposite number is injection-zero-width-split-rejected.
